name: app-black-white-project-task-app-two-screens
title: Black and White Task App Two Screens
whatItIs: Two phones on lavender grey: a home with a black header with wave lines, dark and pale project cards and a task list, and a Today screen with a date strip and a black vertical timeline with a meeting card.
whatItMeans: Monochrome cards with subtle line art feel focused and professional, and the vertical timeline shows the day at a glance.
techniques: Black cards among white for priority
Wave line texture on dark areas
Selected date as a black pill
Floating round plus button in the nav

vocabulary.definition: A row of days with the current one highlighted.
A dot on a vertical line marking an event.
Flowing line art used as a subtle pattern.
